mapper.sql: id, coupon_id, segment_json, matched, granted, skipped, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_coupon_delivery (coupon_id, segment_json, matched, granted, skipped, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{couponId}, #{segmentJson}, coalesce(#{matched}, 0), coalesce(#{granted}, 0), coalesce(#{skipped}, 0), now(), now(), 0)
mapper.select: select count(*) from litemall_coupon_delivery where deleted = 0 and coupon_id = #{couponId}

select (select count(*) from litemall_coupon_user g where g.coupon_id = #{couponId} and g.deleted = 0) as granted, (select count(*) from litemall_coupon_user u where u.coupon_id = #{couponId} and u.deleted = 0 and u.status = 1) as used, count(o.id) as ordersCount, coalesce(sum(o.actual_price), 0) as revenue from litemall_coupon_user cu join litemall_order o on o.id = cu.order_id and o.deleted = 0 where cu.coupon_id = #{couponId} and cu.deleted = 0 and cu.status = 1
